source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20

china_plus_one.evidence: Bosch India's Powertrain Solutions division saw export sales increase in FY25. Company supplies auto components and industrial technology to the Bosch global supply chain. However, exports are driven by intragroup Bosch purchasing rather than customer diversification away from China — no explicit China+1 narrative found in available FY25 press releases.

govt_capex.evidence: Beyond Mobility business segment (building automation, energy tech, industrial solutions) serves power, water, and infrastructure sectors that include government-backed projects. Exact revenue % not disclosed in available press releases.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2024-25 revenue from operations ₹18,087 crore; PAT ₹2,013 crore (11.1% of revenue). Powertrain Solutions division saw export sales grow; Beyond Mobility grew 4.4%. Estimated ~18% export revenue via Bosch global supply chain intragroup sales. Exact export % not disclosed in available FY25 press releases.

china_plus_one.evidence: Pidilite is an India-dominant adhesives and sealants company (Fevicol, Dr. Fixit). International revenue (~24%) comes from overseas subsidiaries serving local markets in ~30 countries — not from India-manufactured export supply chains. No China+1 relevance.

rural.evidence: Pidilite's Consumer & Bazaar segment (Fevicol, M-Seal) is distributed through a wide retail network including semi-urban and rural hardware stores. Specific rural revenue % not separately disclosed in available investor communications.

crude_exposure.evidence: Vinyl Acetate Monomer (VAM), the primary raw material for Fevicol-range adhesives, is a crude/petrochemical derivative. Pidilite's gross margins are meaningfully sensitive to crude oil and VAM prices, but exact % of raw material costs from crude is not disclosed in available FY25 search results.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2024-25 consolidated revenue ₹13,388 crore (+6.9% YoY); net profit ₹2,096 crore (+20% YoY). International subsidiaries contribute ~24% of consolidated revenue (overseas operations in ~30 countries). Revenue from overseas subsidiaries consolidated in local currencies (USD, AED, GBP, etc.). Exact hedging policy not found in available search results.

china_plus_one.evidence: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC is a domestic Indian asset management company earning AUM-based management fees. All revenue is in INR. No export business and no China+1 relevance.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Rate cuts stimulate equity market returns, driving AUM growth and thus higher management fee revenues for ABSL AMC. The company is indirectly rate-sensitive via the equity market channel, not through floating-rate liabilities on its own balance sheet.

inr_exposure.evidence: All revenue in INR. No foreign currency exposure. Overall quarterly average AUM (including alternate assets) grew 15% YoY to ₹4,60,800 crore for Sep 2025 quarter. Mutual fund QAAUM ₹4,25,200 crore.

china_plus_one.evidence: Lupin is a formulations-led pharma company with API manufacturing capabilities. While India reducing China API dependency creates some structural tailwind, no explicit China+1 supply-chain narrative was cited in Lupin's FY25 press release or results announcement.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 total revenues INR 227 Bn (₹22,700 crore). US sales USD 925 Mn (up from USD 815 Mn in FY24), accounting for 38% of global sales. India Region 31% of global sales. Other Developed Markets (including Europe/Australia) 11%. Emerging Markets 11%. API and other ~9%. ~69% of revenues in foreign currencies.

pli_scheme.evidence: Lupin is a significant API manufacturer and among the beneficiaries of India's Production Linked Incentive scheme for pharmaceuticals/APIs. Specific PLI revenue quantum not disclosed in available search results.

china_plus_one.evidence: Ajanta Pharma is a branded generic pharma company focused on India, Africa, and Asia. No China+1 supply chain narrative applicable to its business model of branded formulations.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 consolidated revenue ₹4,648 crore. India domestic 32%, Export 68%. Export markets include US, Africa, Asia ex-India, and other emerging markets. Revenue mix across USD, African currencies, and Asian currencies.

china_plus_one.evidence: Royal Enfield's international volumes surged 29.7% YoY to 100,136 units in FY25 (first time crossing 1 million total annual sales) with CKD units in Thailand, Argentina, Colombia, Brazil, Bangladesh, Nepal. Competing in segments where Chinese brands are present. No explicit China+1 supply-chain or order-attribution narrative found in FY25 press coverage.

rural.evidence: Royal Enfield motorcycles have a significant rural and semi-urban customer base in India; domestic sales grew 8.1% to 902,757 units in FY25. Specific rural revenue % is not separately disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Consumer motorcycle purchases are significantly financed via loans; rate cuts improve affordability and support volume growth. VECV (commercial vehicles) also benefits from infrastructure spending cycles.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 consolidated revenue ₹18,870 crore (+14.1% YoY); PAT ₹4,734 crore (+18.3% YoY). Royal Enfield exported 100,136 motorcycles (+29.7%), domestic sales 902,757 units. Export revenue estimated ~18% of total, reflecting unit share (~10%) plus premium ASP in export markets.

china_plus_one.evidence: Radico Khaitan is a domestic Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) company. No export supply chain or China+1 relevance.

rural.evidence: Radico Khaitan's 8PM and similar brands are popular in the affordable/regular IMFL category with a significant rural and semi-urban buyer base. Prestige & Above category grew 15.5% by volume in FY25; Regular volumes rebounded sharply in Q3-Q4 FY25 after nine consecutive quarters of degrowth. Specific rural revenue % not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: Radico Khaitan derives ~96% of revenue from domestic India IMFL sales. Total IMFL volume grew 9.2% YoY in FY25. Small export component via duty-free and international markets.

china_plus_one.evidence: FSN E-Commerce Ventures (Nykaa) is an India-only beauty and fashion e-commerce platform. No export business and no China+1 relevance.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2024-25 revenue from operations grew 24% YoY to ₹7,950 crore. Gross Profit grew 27% YoY to ₹3,477 crore. EBITDA grew 37% YoY to ₹474 crore. All revenue in INR. No foreign currency exposure.

china_plus_one.evidence: Sun Pharma has API manufacturing capabilities in India which provides some structural benefit from pharma supply chain diversification. No explicit China+1 narrative found in available FY25 MD&A or press releases; the company's growth narrative centres on specialty products and branded generics globally.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 consolidated revenues ₹52,947 crore (+9.2% YoY). India formulation sales ₹16,923 crore = 32% of total. US formulations 30% of total revenue. Emerging Markets 17%. Rest of World 16%. Global Specialty Revenue USD 1,216 million (+17.1% YoY), contributing ~20% of consolidated revenues. ~68% of revenue in foreign currencies (primarily USD).

pli_scheme.evidence: Sun Pharma is one of the largest beneficiaries of India's API PLI scheme for pharmaceuticals. Specific PLI revenue not separately quantified in available search results.

china_plus_one.evidence: JB Pharma's CDMO segment manufactures for international pharma clients and the international branded business (Russia, South Africa) shows export diversification. However, no explicit China+1 framing found in available FY25 press coverage.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 revenue ₹3,918 crore (+12.4% YoY); net profit ₹659.5 crore (+19.3%). Domestic India branded + CDMO = 69% of revenues; International (Russia, South Africa, US, others) = 31%. Q4 domestic grew 11% YoY. CDMO segment and Russia drive international gains. 75% of India branded formulations in progressive, faster-growing therapeutic segments.

china_plus_one.evidence: Dr Lal PathLabs is a domestic Indian diagnostic laboratory chain. No export business and no China+1 relevance.

rural.evidence: Q4 FY25 results highlighted strong volume growth through deeper penetration in Tier-3 and Tier-4 towns, which show higher CAGR within the network. FY25 annual report theme is 'Expanding Access to Advanced Diagnostics'. Q4 revenue ₹603 crore (+10.5% YoY); Q4 profit +81% on geographic expansion.

inr_exposure.evidence: 100% domestic India diagnostic services. Q4 FY25 revenue ₹603 crore. Annual revenue approx ₹2,400 crore. No foreign currency exposure.

china_plus_one.evidence: Caplin Point is a pharma company focused on Latin America and Africa — markets where competition from Chinese manufacturers is not a primary dynamic. No China+1 narrative applicable.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 net sales ₹1,937 crore (+14.4% YoY); operating profit ₹743 crore; net profit ₹541 crore. Company derives ~90-96% of revenues through exports. Latin America and Africa (Emerging Markets) ~76% of total revenue; US market ~20% of total. Domestic India ~4%. Revenue in USD and local LatAm/African currencies.

china_plus_one.evidence: Navin Fluorine International is a key beneficiary of China+1 supply-chain diversification in fluorochemicals and specialty chemicals. Large institutional investors hold NFIL citing China+1 as primary investment thesis. Management has discussed HF capacity additions to compete with Chinese imports and secure upstream supply. CDMO vertical targets USD 100 Mn revenue by FY27, driven by global pharma/agrochemical companies diversifying API and intermediate sourcing away from China. Exports were 77% of Q4 FY25 revenue.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 revenue ₹2,393 crore. Export as % of sales was 77% in Q4 FY25. Business segments: Refrigeration gases, Inorganic Fluorides, Specialty Fluorochemicals, and CDMO. All three verticals (HPP, Specialty, CDMO) showed robust YoY revenue growth. Majority of revenue from outside India.

china_plus_one.evidence: ABB India CEO stated 'Export hub to support other geographies' — ABB India is being positioned as a global manufacturing hub, exported to 50+ countries in CY2024. Record revenue ₹12,188 Cr (+17% YoY), record orders ₹13,079 Cr. ABB India operates across 23 diverse market segments and is positioned as an export manufacturing base for the parent's Asia-Pacific supply chain. No explicit China+1 attribution in available sources.

govt_capex.evidence: ABB India serves Indian Railways (traction electronics, signalling, transformers), state/central utilities (T&D switchgear, transformers), and public infrastructure projects across Electrification, Motion, Process Automation, and Robotics segments. Indirect exposure through EPCs at approximately 35-40% of revenue. Record orders of ₹13,079 Cr driven by data center, power distribution, and public-sector infrastructure.

inr_exposure.evidence: Export revenue approximately 10% of CY2024 total revenue of ₹12,188 crore. ABB India exports to 50+ countries primarily within ABB global group's Asia-Pacific supply network. USD revenue estimated ~10% of total. ABB India follows January-December calendar year.

china_plus_one.evidence: Sai Life Sciences is a CRO/CDMO serving global innovator pharma companies (primarily US and Europe). China+1 / US Biosecure Act tailwind is a direct catalyst — global pharma companies are diversifying API and intermediate manufacturing away from China. NSE investor presentation and analyst coverage highlight China+1 and Biosecure Act as significant growth drivers. The shift of global dynamics due to China+1 and Biosecure Act could bring significant opportunities for Indian CDMO players.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 revenue ₹1,530 crore; EBITDA ₹425 crore (+42% YoY); EBITDA margin 25% (vs 20% in FY24). Company operates exclusively as CDMO/CRO, geographically operates in India (manufacturing/research base) and Outside India (customers). Approximately 95% of revenue from international pharma clients in USD/EUR.

china_plus_one.evidence: Allied Blenders & Distillers is a domestic Indian IMFL company (Officer's Choice, Sterling Reserve). No export manufacturing or China+1 relevance.

rural.evidence: Officer's Choice Whisky is one of the largest-selling whisky brands in India by volume with significant penetration in rural and semi-urban markets. FY2025 EBITDA grew 81.7% YoY to ₹451 crore; PAT ₹195 crore (vs ₹2 crore in FY24). Specific rural revenue % not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: Revenue is almost entirely domestic India IMFL sales. Minimal export component via duty-free channels. FY2024-25 EBITDA ₹451 crore (81.7% growth), PAT ₹195 crore.

china_plus_one.evidence: Torrent Pharma is a branded generic company focused on India, Germany, Brazil, and US. No China+1 supply-chain diversification narrative applicable to its branded formulations business.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 consolidated revenue ₹11,516 crore. Q4 FY25: India ₹1,545 crore (+12% YoY), Germany ₹286 crore (+2%), US ₹302 crore (+15%). Full year US revenues ₹1,100 crore. Ranked #1 Indian pharma in Germany and Brazil. Estimated India ~49%, Export ~51%: Germany ~10%, US ~10%, Brazil ~8%, RoW ~23%. Revenue in INR (~49%), EUR (Germany ~10%), USD (US ~10%), BRL (Brazil ~8%), others.

china_plus_one.evidence: KSB India makes pumps and valves primarily for the domestic Indian market. Not a China+1 beneficiary.

govt_capex.evidence: KSB India's water segment includes significant government-backed irrigation and drinking water projects. FY25 orders include solar pump projects from Rajasthan Horticulture Dept, Maharashtra Energy, MPUVNL, and DGVCL. Also serves thermal power plants and industrial water treatment. Revenue ₹2,696 crore (+6.4% YoY); net profit ₹264.5 crore (+9.8%). Significant portion of revenue tied to government-backed infrastructure capex; exact % not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: KSB India has export orders to Middle East (KSB Pumps Arabia order) and Africa (Hassi Massoud Refinery in Algeria). Estimated export ~15% of FY25 revenue ₹2,696 crore. 220% dividend recommended in FY25.

china_plus_one.evidence: Shyam Metalics is a domestic Indian steel and metals producer. Chinese steel dumping represents a headwind for the company rather than a China+1 tailwind.

govt_capex.evidence: Government infrastructure spending on roads, railways, bridges, and construction drives domestic steel demand. Shyam Metalics makes long steel products (TMT bars, structural steel, ferroalloys, pellets) used in infrastructure construction. Specific govt capex-linked % not disclosed.

crude_exposure.evidence: Coking coal is the primary raw material for steel production; energy-intensive operations use petroleum products (diesel, furnace oil) which are crude-linked. However, coking coal itself is not crude oil. Exact crude-linked raw material % not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 revenue ₹15,370 crore (+17% YoY); net income ₹909 crore (-12% YoY, reflecting higher expenses). Primarily domestic Indian steel sales. Some export sales (~12% estimated). PAT margin decreased to 5.9% from 7.8%.

pli_scheme.evidence: Steel sector has PLI scheme for specialty/high-grade steel. Shyam Metalics' product mix (long products, ferroalloys, pellets) may partially qualify but specific PLI beneficiary status not confirmed in available search results.

china_plus_one.evidence: Triveni Turbine's export order inflows grew 50% YoY in FY25 (vs 4% domestic growth). Export % of Q4 FY25 sales increased to 52% from 48% in Q4 FY24. The company is gaining traction in international markets for industrial steam turbines where Chinese manufacturers compete. No explicit China+1 framing found in available investor brief or press coverage.

govt_capex.evidence: Triveni Turbine manufactures industrial steam turbines for power generation, cogeneration, and waste heat recovery. Some projects serve government-owned utilities and public sector industries. Exact govt-linked % not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 revenue from operations ₹2,006 crore (+21% YoY, record level). Q4 FY25: Domestic ₹2.6 Bn, Export ₹2.8 Bn (52% export). Order inflows grew 25% YoY to ₹5.7 Bn driven by export orders growing 50% vs domestic 4%. Export markets include Europe, Middle East, and Americas. Full year export estimated ~48%.
